instructions: In the image at screenshot: Are the borders or outlines that mark out text fields, checkboxes, or other controls so pale against the background that the controls are hard to see?

criteria.true: The borders or outlines of text fields, checkboxes, or other controls are so pale against the background that the controls are hard to see.
criteria.false: Every text field, checkbox, and other control has a border, outline, or fill that stands out clearly from the background, or the image shows no such controls.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Are links inside running text, the sentences people are meant to read, set apart from the words around them only by their colour, with no underline or other mark?

criteria.true: Links inside running text differ from the words around them only by colour, with no underline, bold, or other mark.
criteria.false: Links inside running text are underlined or marked in some other way besides colour, or the running text holds no links.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Does a form show text fields whose only label is the pale hint text inside the empty field, with no label outside the field?

criteria.true: A form has text fields whose only label is the pale hint text inside the empty field, with no visible label above or beside the field.
criteria.false: Every text field has a visible label above or beside it, or the image shows no form.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Is a form field marked as wrong only by a red border or outline, with no written message that says what is wrong?

criteria.true: A form field is marked as wrong only by a red border or outline, and no written message near it says what is wrong.
criteria.false: Every field marked as wrong has a written message that says what is wrong, or no field is marked as wrong.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Is there a chart or graph with no written labels, axis values, or legend, so a reader cannot tell what its shapes or colours stand for?

criteria.true: A chart or graph has no written labels, axis values, or legend, so a reader cannot tell what its shapes or colours stand for.
criteria.false: Every chart or graph has written labels, axis values, or a legend that say what its shapes and colours stand for, or the image shows no chart.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Is a paragraph of running text, the sentences people are meant to read, set entirely in italic or entirely underlined?

criteria.true: A paragraph of running text of several lines is set entirely in italic or entirely underlined.
criteria.false: Running text is set in upright, plain type, and italic or underline is kept to a few words, such as links or titles.
